description: The figure presents a set of stacked bar charts intended to show a variance decomposition across three task domains (Health and Nutrition, Logistics, and Travel and Transportation) for two model sizes, with each bar partitioned into two components labeled “MVS” and “1‑MVS.” The category axis is horizontal, with domain titles centered above each pair of bars; within each domain, the two categories are “70B llama” followed by “8B llama,” shown as rotated x-axis tick labels. The value axis is vertical with a linear scale from 0 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular 0.2 intervals, and each stacked bar reaches a total height of 1.0. Bars are stacked with a teal/green lower segment labeled “MVS” and a blue upper segment labeled “1‑MVS,” as indicated by the legend centered below the plot. In Health and Nutrition, the 70B llama bar shows MVS at approximately 0.59 and 1‑MVS at approximately 0.41, while the 8B llama bar shows MVS at approximately 0.39 and 1‑MVS at approximately 0.61. In Logistics, the 70B llama bar shows MVS at approximately 0.51 and 1‑MVS at approximately 0.49, and the 8B llama bar shows MVS at approximately 0.48 and 1‑MVS at approximately 0.52. In Travel and Transportation, the 70B llama bar shows MVS at approximately 0.72 and 1‑MVS at approximately 0.28, while the 8B llama bar shows MVS at approximately 0.36 and 1‑MVS at approximately 0.64. The bars appear in a fixed order by domain and then by model size (70B before 8B), with no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or annotations beyond the domain headings and legend.
